title: Clean Architecture solution on .NET 10
body: Domain / Application / Infrastructure / App + xUnit tests. Dependencies point inward. Branches merged per area (value objects, entities, aggregates, services, use cases, adapters, UI, tests).

title: Domain model: value objects, entities, aggregates, services
body: TransitionSpec, Hotkey, AutoHidePolicy, Appearance, GeoLocation, WeatherSnapshot, AgendaEvent, SceneId, WidgetPlacement; Scene, DesktopItem; DesktopSettings, SceneLibrary; DesktopSearch, Agenda. Covered by unit tests.

title: 7 GPU-composited layer transitions
body: Liquid, Fade, Circle, Wipe, Gravity, Wave, Float. Zero per-frame pixel work: layers, regions and moving sprites composed by DWM.

title: Liquid-glass UI
body: Captured + blurred backdrop with saturation boost, lens refraction with chromatic aberration at panel edges, adaptive tint, glass-bubble toggles, sliding lens selectors, frame clock on DwmFlush.

title: Desktop search panel (Ctrl+Alt+F)
body: Draggable glass panel, remembers position, accent-insensitive ranking, recents first, Ctrl+Enter shows in folder.

title: Settings in JSON with import from 1.x
body: %APPDATA%\DesktopPulito\settings.json and scenes.json, atomic writes, automatic import of registry settings.

title: Open-Meteo weather adapter (free, no key)
body: City geocoding + current conditions, WMO code mapping, 15-minute cache in the use case.

title: iCal calendar adapter (Google, Outlook, Apple, Proton…)
body: Reads the secret iCal address: no developer account, no OAuth verification. Line folding, all-day and UTC events, 10-minute cache.

title: Direct3D 11 transitions: Burn, Pixelate, Glitch, Ripple, Ink
body: HLSL shaders via Vortice.Windows (MIT), vsync-paced Present, fallback to Liquid without GPU. Code merged; live verification and tuning in progress.

title: Scenes page in settings
body: Create/rename/delete scenes, pick wallpaper, icons on/off, entry transition, activate. Ctrl+Alt+S already switches scene. Branch: feature/scenes-page.

title: Glass widgets: clock, weather, agenda
body: Pinned to the desktop layer, zero CPU while static, per-scene placement, drag to move. Uses GetWeather / GetAgenda use cases.

title: Weather city and calendar link settings
body: Glass text fields in settings; validation already in the domain (DesktopSettings.SetCalendarUrl).

title: Transitions visible in screen recordings
body: Effects that need to capture under their own layers are hidden from recorders. Render the 'after' state without screen capture (wallpaper file + icon sprites) so every effect can be recorded for videos.

title: Recurring calendar events (RRULE)
body: Expand daily/weekly/monthly recurrences from iCal feeds.

title: Free theme gallery on GitHub
body: JSON index + assets in a public repo; one-click install of scenes/themes; export/import .dptheme files.

title: Privacy-friendly unread mail counter
body: Gmail full read scope is 'restricted' (paid security assessment for public apps): find a free, privacy-friendly way to show unread counts.

title: Plugin API for transitions and widgets
body: Let contributors add effects and widgets without touching the core.

title: Installer and .NET 10 runtime check
body: Single-file build is 1 MB and needs the free .NET 10 Desktop Runtime: detect it and guide the user, or publish a self-contained variant.
